links.outcome: Preventive care-gap closure with chatbot outreach versus phone, email, mail, and multichannel outreach
links.effect: Phone outreach achieved higher compliance than chatbot or multichannel outreach across most groups and years; chatbot beat phone only for diabetes care in 2023 (OR 1.81, 95% CI 1.48-2.21).
links.quote: Phone outreach consistently achieved higher compliance than chatbot or multichannel outreach across most groups and years.

unlisted_practices: Segmenting outreach modality by patient population, for example using chatbot outreach for digitally engaged diabetic patients
Maintaining primary care physician continuity to support care-gap closure

screen.reason: Evaluates the comparative effectiveness of automated chatbot SMS outreach versus traditional communication methods (phone, email, mail) in real patient care-gap closure across a health system.
